lurchSource.comment: vendor/lurch/<commit>/{lde,lurchmath} are fetched from this commit by bin/vendor-lurch.mjs (via the postinstall script), not committed to git. This commit also determines the URL the vendored tree is served at (config/initializers/lurch_vendor.rb) and that bin/build.mjs rewrites this app's own /lurchmath/* imports to. Bump `commit` to pull in upstream changes.
